notes: The union camporee is held every five years; 2027 returns to Summit Bechtel Reserve after 2022 ("Relentless").
Union Online Prayer Meetings are dated only to 2 Dec 2026 (Visitor, "Pray With Us in 2026").
Homeland Missions funding: the latest brochure and application on the union site are for 2025 (due 13 Feb 2025); no 2026 or 2027 cycle is posted.
The union executive committee report (Visitor, Sept 2026) mentions Share Your Table, OneVoice 2027/All Things New, Ignite Ohio and Impact Philly, but gives no union-wide 2027 dates.
Union education events also appear on the Chesapeake feed (Principals Boot Camp, K-12 Encounter, SALT) with the same dates.
